g.text: Allocate Job — Sequence Diagram (UML 2.5.1, as built after refactoring)
solid line, filled arrowhead: synchronous call
solid line, open arrowhead: asynchronous signal (user gesture)
dashed line, open arrowhead: reply (return value or exception)
Same messages on every storage. With DB_URL=memory: the DAOs are in-memory
(InMemoryTransactionAdapter), and the :Database lifeline is not used.
